result.instructions: Tools for Papershift, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is absent next week, and which absence requests are still pending?"; "How many vacation days does Anna have left this year?"; "Show last week's tracked hours for the Berlin location.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Papershift data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run papershift_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run papershift_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run papershift_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. papershift_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: papershift_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The Papershift account this API key belongs to (id and name). A quick way to check the connection. GET /accounts.

tools.name: papershift_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List all locations (sites/companies inside the account) with id, name and status. Most other tools need a location id from here. GET /locations.

tools.name: papershift_get_location
tools.title: Get location
tools.description: One location by id. GET /locations?id=.

tools.name: papershift_list_working_areas
tools.title: List working areas
tools.description: List working areas (departments/stations shifts are planned in), optionally for one location. Use the ids for shifts and time trackings. GET /working_areas.

location_id.description: Only the working areas of this location.

tools.name: papershift_list_users
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List employees (users) with name, email, status, contract basics and their location, working-area and tag ids. Filter by location, working area or tag. 25 per page. GET /users.

working_area_id.description: Only employees in this working area.

tag_ids.description: Only records with one of these tag ids (from papershift_list_tags). Include 0 to also match records without tags.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1; 25 records per page). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: papershift_get_user
tools.title: Get employee
tools.description: One employee by id: contact data, status, locations, working areas, tags and profile fields. GET /users?id=.

tools.name: papershift_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List the tags of a location (labels on shifts, time trackings and employees). GET /filters.

tools.name: papershift_list_absence_types
tools.title: List absence types
tools.description: List the absence types of a location (vacation, sick leave, ...) with id, title and rules. Use the ids to create absences. GET /absence_types.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1; 25 records per page). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: papershift_list_absences
tools.title: List absences
tools.description: List absences (vacation, sick leave, ...) that fall between two dates, optionally for one employee or location. Shows type title, times, hours, vacation days and whether it is confirmed. 25 per page. GET /absences.

range_start.description: First day of the range, yyyy-mm-dd.

range_end.description: Last day of the range, yyyy-mm-dd.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1; 25 records per page). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: papershift_get_absence
tools.title: Get absence
tools.description: One absence by id, with its status, confirmation, hours and vacation days. GET /absences?id=.

tools.name: papershift_list_vacation_entitlements
tools.title: List vacation entitlements
tools.description: An employee's vacation entitlements (planned days, spent days, expiry, carry-over) for the given period. Use it to answer 'how many vacation days does X have left'. 25 per page. GET /vacation_entitlements.

start_date.description: Only entitlements from this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

end_date.description: Only entitlements up to this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1; 25 records per page). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: papershift_list_time_trackings
tools.title: List time trackings
tools.description: List worked-time entries (clock-ins) from a start date, optionally to an end date and for one employee. Shows start, end, break time, location, employee and whether confirmed. 25 per page. GET /working_sessions.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1; 25 records per page). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: papershift_get_time_tracking
tools.title: Get time tracking
tools.description: One worked-time entry by id, with its breaks, tags and break total. GET /working_sessions?id=.

tools.name: papershift_list_evaluations
tools.title: List evaluations (daily hours)
tools.description: An employee's daily evaluations: target, planned and actual hours, vacation and compensation per day. Use it for overtime and balance questions. 25 per page. GET /evaluations.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1; 25 records per page). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: papershift_list_target_hours
tools.title: List target hours
tools.description: An employee's contractual target hours (weekly/monthly rhythm and hours per weekday) over time. 25 per page. GET /target_hours.

start_date.description: Only entries from this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

end_date.description: Only entries up to this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1; 25 records per page). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: papershift_list_payrolls
tools.title: List payrolls
tools.description: An employee's payroll entries (paid hours, salary, bonus, time-account start/end per period). Sensitive pay data. 25 per page. GET /payrolls.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1; 25 records per page). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: papershift_list_shifts
tools.title: List shifts
tools.description: List planned shifts of a location between two dates, optionally for one working area or tags. Shows start, end, number of employees needed, note and visibility. Assigned employees: papershift_list_shift_assignments. 25 per page. GET /shifts.

tag_ids.description: Only records with one of these tag ids (from papershift_list_tags). Include 0 to also match records without tags.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1; 25 records per page). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: papershift_get_shift
tools.title: Get shift
tools.description: One shift by id. GET /shifts?id=.

tools.name: papershift_list_shift_assignments
tools.title: List shift assignments
tools.description: Who is assigned to a shift and who has applied for it (user id and name). GET /assignments?shift_id=.

tools.name: papershift_list_availabilities
tools.title: List availabilities
tools.description: The times an employee has marked as available between two dates. 25 per page. GET /availabilities.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1; 25 records per page). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: papershift_create_absence
tools.title: Create absence
tools.description: WRITE: record an absence (vacation, sick leave, ...) for an employee. Get the absence type id from papershift_list_absence_types and the user id from papershift_list_users. Whether it counts immediately or waits for approval depends on the absence type and the account's approval rules; the employee may be notified. Papershift calculates the paid hours and vacation days. POST /absences.

starts_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-11-02T08:00:00+01:00.

ends_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-11-02T08:00:00+01:00.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the times, e.g. Europe/Berlin (recommended).

tools.name: papershift_review_absence
tools.title: Confirm, reject or reset an absence
tools.description: WRITE: decide on an absence request. action 'confirm' approves it (it then counts against vacation days and the plan), 'reject' declines it, 'reset' puts a decided absence back to pending. The employee is typically notified of the decision. Find ids with papershift_list_absences. PUT /absences/{confirm|reject|reset}.

tools.name: papershift_create_time_tracking
tools.title: Create time tracking
tools.description: WRITE: add a worked-time entry for an employee after the fact (start, end and break minutes) in a location and working area. It changes the employee's recorded hours and balance. Ids from papershift_list_locations, papershift_list_working_areas and papershift_list_users. POST /working_sessions.

location_id.description: Location the work was done in.

working_area_id.description: Working area the work was done in.

starts_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-11-02T08:00:00+01:00.

ends_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-11-02T08:00:00+01:00.

tools.name: papershift_confirm_time_tracking
tools.title: Confirm time tracking
tools.description: WRITE: confirm (approve) a worked-time entry so it counts as final for payroll and balances. Find ids with papershift_list_time_trackings. PUT /working_sessions/confirm.

tools.name: papershift_create_shift
tools.title: Create shift
tools.description: WRITE: plan a new shift in a location and working area for a number of employees. Set visible to true only if employees should see it right away (default: left to the account's setting). Assign people afterwards with papershift_assign_user_to_shift. POST /shifts.

starts_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-11-02T08:00:00+01:00.

ends_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-11-02T08:00:00+01:00.

number_of_employees.description: How many employees the shift needs.

note.description: Optional note shown on the shift.

visible.description: Whether employees can see the shift (published).

tag_ids.description: Tag ids to put on the shift (papershift_list_tags).

tools.name: papershift_assign_user_to_shift
tools.title: Assign employee to shift
tools.description: WRITE: put an employee on a shift (or, with application true, record them as having applied for it). The employee is typically notified of the assignment. An already assigned user is re-assigned. Returns the shift's assigned and applied users. POST /assignments.

application.description: True = record as an application instead of assigning directly.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Papershift
prompts.description: What you can do with Papershift here, with example requests to try.
